activity.notes: Sir Douglas Ralph ('Doug') Nicholls (1906–1988), a Yorta Yorta Australian Aboriginal minister and rights advocate, co-founded the Victorian Aborigines Advancement League in May 1957 with Doris Blackburn, Stan Davey and Gordon Bryant. This year-level Activity represents the specifically documented League founding, not an invented start or end for all his Indigenous rights campaigning. He also participated in the 1938 Day of Mourning and was later appointed Governor of South Australia; his separate vice-regal term is recorded in the companion request. `active_in` records public campaigning, not elected governmental office.
